description: This file defines the Length class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for handling length unit conversions, formatting, and retrieving length units based on length class IDs.

classes.name: Length
classes.description: A class for managing length units and conversions in the shopping cart context.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length value from one length class to another based on stored unit values.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a length value into a human-readable string with units.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the unit string for a given length class ID.
